description:
Run the Strategy Engine route in one call. Use it FIRST whenever someone asks to build or make a strategy and names no signals -- 'build me a strategy', 'build me a BTC strategy on 1h', 'make me something for ETH'. Give the asset, and the candle size only when they named one. The server reads the 180-day regime, searches the engine's completed runs once with the agreed floors (more than 10 trades, Sharpe at least 1, IRR at least 10%, beats benchmarks) in that regime, keeps the runs whose entry the regime admits, picks one at random, saves it from its own run and backtests it on recent data ending today, over a window its candle size sets: 5m 1 month, 15m 2 months, 30m 3 months, 1h 4 months, 4h 12 months, 1d 12 months (a month is 30 days). Do not pass filters, a regime or dates: they are fixed. When nothing fits it answers with outcome no_match and saves and spends nothing. A fresh build selects its market automatically; do not ask for a venue or quote. It does not search the marketplace.

[Access: pay 0.10 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

asset.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC or ETH.

candle_size.description: Duration of one candle, e.g. 1h or 1d.

name: build_strategy_for_regime
